unmanagedUiStrings.source:
`2026-10-05`

### Message of the day

# Welcome to Hollama: a simple web interface for [Ollama](https://ollama.ai)

#### What's new?

- **Reasoning is back** for thinking models like `qwen3` and `gpt-oss`, on Ollama and OpenAI-compatible servers. Thanks [@AndSDev](https://github.com/AndSDev)!
- **Italian and Georgian translations**, thanks to [@Manu-sh](https://github.com/Manu-sh) and [@EkaterinePapava](https://github.com/EkaterinePapava).
- **Multiple tabs stay in sync** and no longer overwrite each other's sessions.
- **Desktop app** opens links in your browser, and the download is less than half the size.

#### Previously, in Hollama

- **Submit images as prompts** without entering text.
- **Redesigned sidebar navigation** with improved accessibility and mobile experience.
- **Copy & paste images** directly into the prompt field for quick image attachments.
- **Improved stop completion** now preserves partial responses instead of discarding them.

#### Community Resources

- [Deploying Hollama & Ollama on Kubernetes](https://github.com/prudhvikrishnap/h-ollama-on-k8s/blob/main/guide.md) by [@prudhvikrishnap](https://github.com/prudhvikrishnap/h-ollama-on-k8s/commits?author=prudhvikrishnap)

#### Contributions

We welcome contributions from people familiar with **Svelte**, **TypeScript** and **TailwindCSS**.
If that sparks your interest, read this next: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/fmaclen/hollama/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

#### About

Created by [@fmaclen](https://fernando.is), made with the help of [contributors](https://github.com/fmaclen/hollama/graphs/contributors)
unmanagedUiStrings.context: Body of the /motd page (Message of the day). Confirmed in scope: the whole Markdown document is user-facing content that should be translated, including headings, list items and surrounding prose. Links, names, handles and the date line must stay unchanged. Phase B serves a per-locale markdown file rather than a dictionary key.
unmanagedUiStrings.decision: CONFIRMED: include in the translation scope. Translate the Markdown prose only; keep URLs, handles and the ISO date line unchanged.

reviewNotes.note: Sidebar metadata and knowledge/session subtitles use date-fns formatDistanceToNow with the default locale, so relative times such as '2 hours ago' stay in English whatever the UI language is. Localizing them needs a date-fns locale mapping, which is a Phase B code decision, not a dictionary entry.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED (Phase B): add the date-fns `ca` locale and map the active UI locale to it so relative timestamps are localized.

reviewNotes.note: src/app.html hard-codes <html lang="en"> and the static <title>Hollama</title>. Phase B should consider setting lang dynamically when the locale changes. Not a translatable dictionary entry.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED (Phase B): set <html lang> from the active locale. The document title stays the brand name "Hollama"; it is not translated.

reviewNotes.topic: Language names in the language selector
reviewNotes.note: Settings › Interface lists each language by its own native name (English, Deutsch, 中文 (简体), Español, ...). These look like translatable strings but are intentionally not translated; Catalan should be added as 'Català'. Left out of the export on purpose.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED: language names stay in their native form and out of the export. Phase B adds Catalan as "Català".

reviewNotes.topic: Example placeholder values in Connection settings
reviewNotes.note: The model filter input uses the fixed placeholder 'gpt' and the label input uses 'my-llama-server'. Both are example values rather than prose, so they are not exported; decide in Phase B whether they should become translatable or stay fixed.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED: keep "gpt" and "my-llama-server" unchanged. They stay out of the export and are not parameterized.

reviewNotes.topic: GitHub link label in the sidebar
reviewNotes.note: The sidebar renders a link with the literal text 'GitHub'. It is a product name and is intentionally not translatable.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED: "GitHub" stays untranslated as a product name.

reviewNotes.note: The /motd page renders src/routes/motd/motd.md, which is authored English content, not interface chrome. It is user-facing but out of scope for the dictionary; the project would need a content-translation decision (per-locale markdown) if it should be localized.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED (Phase B): include the /motd content. Its body is exported as the "motd" entry in unmanagedUiStrings so it is translated with everything else; Phase B serves a per-locale markdown file.

reviewNotes.note: Toast descriptions sometimes show values produced outside the app: Ollama pull progress statuses (response.status, e.g. 'pulling manifest'), server error messages (response.error) and raw JS error strings (error.toString()). These are protocol/model output and should not be translated; only the surrounding generic titles are in the dictionary.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED: only app-owned strings are translated. Ollama pull statuses, response.error values and raw error.toString() output stay in English.

reviewNotes.topic: Thrown error messages in the chat layer
reviewNotes.note: src/lib/chat/ollama.ts throws English Error messages such as 'Ollama response is missing body', 'Failed to fetch Ollama tags' and 'Failed to parse Ollama tags'. They are developer-facing but can reach the UI through error.toString() in the chat error toast description. Decide whether to translate them as technical detail or keep them in English.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED (Phase B): translate the app-owned messages thrown in src/lib/chat/ollama.ts by moving them into the English dictionary. Raw upstream error text appended to them stays English.

reviewNotes.note: electron/main.js shows Electron's native dialog.showErrorBox('Error', error.message). This runs outside the Svelte i18n runtime and cannot use typesafe-i18n directly; decide separately whether the desktop shell should be localized.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED (Phase B): translate the app-owned desktop error dialog. It needs a small mechanism to pass localized strings (or the active locale) into electron/main.js.

reviewNotes.note: Eight keys have no use site in the current source tree and are exported unchanged so the key set stays identical to src/i18n/en/index.ts: dangerZone, disconnected, goToKnowledge, modelNotFound, noApiKey, somethingWentWrong, stopResponse, version. Confirm whether they should be translated or dropped from the English base dictionary before Phase B.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED: translate all eight. They stay in the English base dictionary and in the export unchanged.

reviewNotes.note: Several entries are sentence fragments completed by inline elements at the call site: allowConnections (origin badge + 'See docs' link), browseModels (library link), creatingTunnel and allowMixedContent (joined by 'or' plus a literal final period), couldntCheckForUpdates and isCurrentVersionLatest (followed by links), isLatestVersion (followed by a version badge and link), tryingToConnectNotLocalhost (HTML with inline code badges). The translator must keep them fragment-shaped so the pieces still read correctly together.
reviewNotes.decision: CONFIRMED: keep every fragment fragment-shaped so the inline markup that follows still reads correctly. No English source change.
